test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that corrects the misspelt words in the given sentence.

A number of measres have been sugested by her.

options.text: A number of measrues have been sugessted by her.
A number of measures have been sujjested by her.
A number of measures have been suggested by her
A number of mesures have been suggested by her.

solution:
The correct option is 3)** A number of measures have been suggested by her.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The words "measres" and "sugested" in the original sentence are misspelled.
 
• The correct spelling of these words is "**measures**" and "**suggested**" respectively.
 
• Therefore, **option 3**) correctly spells these words and is the correct option.
 
• **Option 1**) misspells "measures" and "suggested".
 
• **Option 2**) misspells "measures" and has an extra letter in "suggested". Option 4) misspells "measures".
